description: Lists the approval queue (filled by queue_adjustment) from the local file only: no Suunto call, writes nothing. Status: pending, expired (not decided before expiresAt: can no longer be approved, can still be rejected), approved, rejected. `status` filters; with `id` the item in full: `payload`, `call` (the DRY-RUN form, push_week_plan with dryRun true: never a ready real push) and `howToPush`.

id.description: One approval's id, e.g. 'a3', for the full item.

status.description: pending, expired, done (approved or rejected) or all (default).

name: list_approvals
title: List the approval queue (pending, expired, done)
